<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Entity Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising parser comment handler paths -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings <child>&internal;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department)*>
  <!ELEMENT department (employee)*>
  <!ELEMENT employee (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY deptName "Research and Development">
  <!ENTITY % paramMacro "<!ENTITY globalNotice 'Confidential Information Only'>">
  %paramMacro;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY handbook SYSTEM "handbook.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="compiler" data="optimize=true debug=false"?>
<enterprise xmlns="http://corp.org/ns" xmlns:hr="http://corp.org/ns/hr" xmlns:sec="http://corp.org/ns/security">
  <!-- Company directory tree comment -->
  <hr:department id="d1">
    <hr:employee>
      <![CDATA[
        Employee bio with special characters: <script>alert(1)</script> &globalNotice;
      ]]>
    </hr:employee>
    <sec:employee>&globalNotice; - &deptName;</sec:employee>
  </hr:department>
</enterprise>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY baseRef "Archive-Record-Base">
  <!ENTITY recursiveRef "&baseRef;-Extension">
  <!ENTITY % pe "
    <!ELEMENT metadata (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY peEntity 'Parameter Entity Text'>
  ">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<archive xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/archive" xmlns:meta="http://schemas.example.com/archive/meta">
  <!-- Comment wrapping around recursive entity references and CDATA -->
  <record meta:id="rec-001">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw archive payload: &recursiveRef; and &peEntity;
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&recursiveRef;</record>
  <metadata>&peEntity;</metadata>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY brand "Acme Corp">
  <!ENTITY tagline "Quality Products Since 1999">
  <!NOTATION svg SYSTEM "image/svg+xml">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.svg" NDATA svg>
  <!ENTITY % outerEntity "<!ENTITY innerEntity '&brand; - &tagline;'>">
  %outerEntity;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:product="http://catalog.org/ns/product" xmlns:core="http://catalog.org/ns/core">
  <!-- Catalog items definition comment block -->
  <product:item core:id="p1">
    <![CDATA[
      Product description with embedded tags: <item>&innerEntity;</item>
    ]]>
  </product:item>
  <product:item>&innerEntity;</product:item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemA "Widget Alpha">
  <!ENTITY itemB "Widget Beta &itemA;">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ENTITY macroText 'Macro Expanded Value'>">
  %dtdMacro;
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY blueprint SYSTEM "blueprint.tiff" NDATA tiff>
]>
<?xml-log level="info" date="2023-10-01"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:wh="http://inventory.org/ns/warehouse" xmlns:log="http://inventory.org/ns/log">
  <!-- Warehouse stock inventory comment with nested structures -->
  <wh:stock log:status="active">
    <![CDATA[
      Stock tracking logs: <stock>&itemB;</stock> ¯oText;
    ]]>
  </wh:stock>
  <wh:stock>&itemB;</wh:stock>
</inventory>
```
